protocol.warmup: one complete prompt group before each dataset and batch-size case; counter deltas exclude it
protocol.uncertainty: paired prompt-group percentile bootstrap, 200000 resamples, seed 20261101; pair identical prompt IDs at identical batching; both aggregate ratios recomputed per resample
protocol.screening_rule: one-sided 95% lower bootstrap bounds with Bonferroni correction across 16 cases x 2 metrics; lower bounds must exceed minus the respective margin; otherwise inconclusive or a regression requiring investigation
limits: Screening margins are practical tolerances, not proof of exact equality.
Acceptance is workload and sampling dependent; results cover these greedy text workloads only.
Output trajectories can diverge under floating-point changes; token hashes, lengths and truncation counts are recorded.
Per-position rates use all draft rounds as denominator, not only rounds that reached that position.

dataset_provenance.protocol: First 64 GSM8K test questions; all 80 MT-Bench first turns; standard acceptance-test formatting; thinking disabled; no few-shot examples.
